Per-Simulation Performance Indicators

Source: R/performance_metrics.R
Calc_PM_Stats.Rd

Calculates the value of each performance indicator (PI) for each simulation and MP, over the years the CMPs are active (see PM_Window_Years(); _Short, _Medium, and _Long are the first 10, middle, and last 10 years). The PIs of the candidate management objectives (Table 1 of the MSE specifications):

Usage

Calc_PM_Stats(
  MSE,
  Lim = 0.17,
  StabilityThreshold = 0.1,
  NoChangeThreshold = 0.01,
  FTarget_FMSY = NULL,
  CatchRefYears = 2008:2010,
  TS = Extract_MSE_Timeseries(MSE, FTarget_FMSY = FTarget_FMSY)
)

Arguments

MSE

An mse object.

Lim

Numeric. Limit reference point as a fraction of the equilibrium unfished spawning biomass. Default 0.17.

StabilityThreshold

Numeric. Maximum TAC change for Stability. Default 0.1.

NoChangeThreshold

Numeric. Maximum TAC change counted as no management change for NoChange. Default 0.01 (the CMPs leave the TAC unchanged when the change would be less than 1%).

FTarget_FMSY

Numeric. The F target relative to FMSY (see Calc_FTarget_FMSY()), used for the default TS. Default NULL (no Status or FTarget_F).

CatchRefYears

Numeric. Historical years of the reference catch for Yield_Hist. Default 2008:2010.

TS

The output of Extract_MSE_Timeseries() for MSE, if already calculated.

Value

A data.frame with columns PI, MP, Sim, and Value.

Details

  • Safety, Safety_*: probability that SB > Lim SB0 in every year, i.e. a simulation that falls below the LRP in any year is a breach.

  • Status: probability that F <= F target (proportion of years), and FTarget_F: median F target / F. Only if TS has F_FTarget.

  • Stability: probability that the TAC changes by no more than StabilityThreshold between management cycles.

  • NoChange: probability of no management change, i.e. that the TAC changes by no more than NoChangeThreshold between management cycles.

  • Yield_Hist: probability that the annual catch is at least the mean catch in CatchRefYears (proportion of years).

and other PIs:

  • Yield_*: mean annual catch.

  • Depletion_*: mean SB/SB0; Depletion_Min: lowest SB/SB0.

  • Kobe_Green: probability that SB > SBMSY and F < FMSY in the same year.

  • SB_SBMSY_All, F_FMSY_All: mean SB/SBMSY and F/FMSY.

  • AAVY: mean absolute relative TAC change between management cycles.
